scope: Kind-9 raw pixel layout and EMS mask/composition contract. No physical EGA, atlas-addressing, or framebuffer equivalence claim.

evidence: Each tile iterates four EGA Map Mask values 1, 2, 4, 8.
Each selected plane copies sixteen words with MOVSW; ADD SI,6 advances from one two-byte plane word to the next row's word.
SUB SI,78h followed by ADD SI,78h makes the full source advance 0x80 bytes per tile: sixteen rows of four two-byte plane words.
Each plane contributes two bytes per row, so the source tile is 16x16 pixels in plane-interleaved-row order: p0[2], p1[2], p2[2], p3[2].
Unrolled body contains sixteen mask-word reads, sixty-four life-plane word reads, and sixty-four base LODSW reads.
The source frame cursor advances 160 bytes: sixteen rows, each containing one two-byte mask and four two-byte color planes.
For each word, XOR overlay/base; AND with mask; XOR base implements base XOR ((overlay XOR base) AND mask). A set mask bit selects the overlay color bit; a clear mask bit preserves the base bit.
Four output words per row are written to _g_3D20, totaling 128 bytes.
Calls _o00_31AD_2B1A, then calls _o00_31AD_0CF9 with _g_3D20 and width/height 16,16.
Kind-9 IDs 9/10 are the ground atlases selected by ground selection.
Kind-9 IDs 15-17 and 18-20 are separately grouped for surface and nest EMS content.

original_helper_differential.readback_fixture: The fixture supplies bytes that the selected EGA read plane would return at DS:g3DB0+col; source function and output scratch execute unmodified in Unicorn.

limitations: No EGA device model: physical graphics-controller read-map behavior is not exercised.
The atlas placement/address calculation from g_94E4 through row/col is not differentially validated.
The _o00_31AD_2FDA display call and DOS clipping/framebuffer effects are excluded.

The existing tile-layout-review.json remains unchanged as the historical rejection of geometry claims based only on resource size and pointer stride; this supplement adds instruction-level source evidence and a normalized-readback helper differential.
